domain: Patch My PC and vendor installers

patterns.title: Patch My PC install returned a non-zero exit code
regex: (?:Installation finished\. Exit code:|End of installation\. Exit code is:|End of Script Runner\. Exit code is:|Exiting With code:)\s*(?P<detail>-?(?!0(?![0-9]))\d+)
patterns.summary: ScriptRunner finished with exit code {detail}. Patch My PC passes the installer's own exit code through, so this tells you the install failed but not why.

remediation.detail: ScriptRunner names it in the 'Running EXE File ... /l=' line; that file is in C:\ProgramData\PatchMyPCInstallLogs.
Check the vendor's documented exit codes for this installer.

patterns.title: Patch My PC pre-install script failed
patterns.summary: A pre-install script ({detail}) returned a failure code and the install was set to stop when that happens.

remediation.detail: Run it as SYSTEM with the same arguments and read the output.
If the clean-up is optional, change the 'abort on fail' option on the Patch My PC app.

patterns.title: Patch My PC aborted the install
patterns.summary: ScriptRunner stopped the install deliberately, typically because of a running process or a failed check.

remediation.detail: The reason is logged just before the abort.

patterns.title: A blocking process was running
patterns.summary: The app being updated was running and blocked the install.

remediation.detail: Allow Patch My PC to close the process, or schedule updates outside working hours.

patterns.title: Dell Update Package reported a failure
patterns.summary: The Dell Update Package finished with the result '{detail}'. A DEP_* code means a dependency or prerequisite was not satisfied; the specific one is logged earlier.

remediation.detail: Search the DUP log for 'needs to be installed', 'not supported' or 'Setup aborted'.
